name: Fresh SRD 5.1 Synthetic Playground
tone: grounded low-fantasy frontier; dangerous roads, uneasy neighbors, small mercies

jobs.brief: Establish a playable opening around a small river market town and a ruined watchtower a short ride away. Create the market town and one nearby dangerous location, with a usable route between them.
Populate the market town with two publicly visible locals: one who needs help and one with useful knowledge about the old watchtower.
Create one local quest about the ruined watchtower and two discoverable clues, grounded in the town and its people.
Create one grounded encounter at the ruined watchtower suitable for a level-1 party, with a non-combat resolution option.
